status: iOS native dependencies compiled; Windows integration under development, not device-validated
route: Triton WDDM KMD + Neptune ARM64X UMD + shared batched transport + native DXMT on Metal

components.title: viogpu3d: keep the monitor's identity across window sizes
triton: give pixel shaders full coverage under target-independent rasterization
d3d11: track all 32 vertex buffer slots

components.note: macos-next; paired with native DXMT by upstream build source list; built as iOS ARM64, same-process threads, no Venus/EGL

limitations: Transport, shared page aperture and Metal scanout are implemented in development; native renderer integration and guest D3D11/DWM remain unverified.
ARM64X covers native ARM64 and ARM64EC/x64-emulated UMD callers; 32-bit applications need a separate x86 UMD.
Initial iOS target is Direct3D 11; the macOS D3DMetal path is not an iPad runtime.
Pinned DXMT and renderer both use directx-native ABI 1; Windows v0.5 package is staged locally, not installed.
